newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB leaves discount rate unchanged at 1.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: SNB leaves discount rate unchanged at 1.00 pct.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said it left its discount rate unchanged at 1.00 percent at a regular weekly meeting of its policy-setting three-man board.
"No change," said an SNB press spokesman in answer to an enquiry.
The discount rate was last changed when it was lowered from 1.50 percent on September 26, 1996.
The rate now matches the historic low maintained from February 1978 to November 1979. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
